scenicChapters.title: Snowdonia Llanberis Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through. 39 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
